files.spike/packs/ai-mcp/Dockerfile.inspector:
# MCP Inspector CLI, pinned. MIT license.
# Built with network access (npm install). Run with a private lab network only.
# Build: docker build -f spike/packs/ai-mcp/Dockerfile.inspector -t touchstone/mcp-inspector:0.17.2 spike/packs/ai-mcp
FROM node:20-slim
RUN npm install -g @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@0.17.2 && npm cache clean --force
ENV HOME=/tmp
WORKDIR /work
ENTRYPOINT ["mcp-inspector"]
files.spike/packs/ai-mcp/lab/mcp/oracle/Docker:
# Built with network access (npm install), run with none.
# The image is the fixed lab artifact. It is never copied into a run workspace.
FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY server.mjs .
EXPOSE 8080
USER node
CMD ["node", "server.mjs"]
